App names, packages, usage and unlock times, and flow statistics stay on this device. No internet permission is requested. Screens, input, keys, notification content and screenshots are not read.

Source data and reports cover only the last 7 days. Cloud backup and device transfer are disabled. Expired data cannot be physically deleted while the app is not running; cleanup occurs on its next run.

No foreground or accessibility service runs. There is no screen-off polling, but a system-started worker still has a small overhead. Zero power use cannot be guaranteed.

Flows show foreground entry order, not actual taps. Split-screen does not imply a single focus. Missing endings are marked unknown rather than invented.
All sessions, unlock records, flows and reports will be deleted, and tracking will pause.

App names, packages, foreground start/end times and unlock times will be recorded after permission is granted, for duration, opens, unlocks and flow charts. Home app usage is excluded.

No screen or interaction content is collected. Data stays on-device for 7 days and is not uploaded. Background collection may be delayed or incomplete.
